_doc: RoboPaint kaishu (楷书 臨帖) targets: slug (pinyin; the codepoint is appended on a collision, e.g. shu-66f8; a work joins the pinyin of its characters), the character(s), the structure (single 独体 | left-right 左右 | top-bottom 上下 | enclosure 包围 | work), the difficulty tier (by the stroke count: <= 5 medium, 6-10 hard, 11+ hard, works extreme). All TRADITIONAL forms (lead, 02:48); characters commonly practised in regular-script copybooks; together they cover the eight basic strokes of 永字八法 (dot, horizontal, vertical, left-falling, right-falling, rising, turning, hook). Works: four-character idioms laid out in two columns read right to left, top to bottom, one 96 mm box per character. Since 2026-10-08 (owner) two works only: 永字八法 and 麟鳳龜龍 (docs/benchmarks/robopaint.md, Targets).
